title: Equipment
description: A mundane item a character can buy, carry or wear: weapons, armour, tools, kits, clothing, medical supplies and consumables. Enhanced and modified gear is a separate content type. The fields a shop list needs (category, cost, weight) are always present; the combat fields appear only on the categories that use them.

key.description: Stable slug identifying this item. Derived from the name once and never reused, so inventories keep resolving after a rename.

name.description: Display name in sentence case, as printed on the equipment tables.

sourceKey.description: Key of the source this item was published in, matching a document of the source content type. Values present in the archive are phb, wh, snv and ec.

contentSet.description: Whether this item belongs to the core rules or to the community expanded-content supplement.

category.description: What kind of item this is. It drives which section of the equipment tables the item is printed in and which of the optional blocks below apply: only weapon carries damage and weaponClassification, and only armor carries armorClass and armorClassification.

costInCredits.description: List price in credits. This is the standard price before haggling or local scarcity, and it is a whole number because the archive holds no fractional credit prices.

weight.description: Weight in pounds, counting against carrying capacity. Fractional to a quarter pound. Items too light to matter are recorded as 0 rather than omitted, so encumbrance maths never has to guess.

description.description: Markdown explaining what the item does beyond its table row. Omit for items whose table row says everything; roughly half of the archived corpus has no description and that is fine.

properties.description: Weapon and armour properties as printed on the table row, one clause per entry, each carrying its own numeric argument: "burst 2", "power cell (range 90/360)", "strength 15". The leading word of each clause names a property defined in the weapon-property or armor-property content type.

weaponClassification.description: Proficiency group the weapon belongs to, pairing its family (blaster, vibroweapon, lightweapon) with its training tier. A character is proficient with a weapon only if proficient with its whole classification. Present on weapons only.

damage.description: Damage on a hit, before ability modifiers and properties. Present only on weapons that deal damage on their own; omit it for weapons whose damage comes entirely from a property such as double or versatile.

dieFaces.description: Faces on each die: the 8 of 2d8.

type.description: Damage type, which decides how resistances, immunities and vulnerabilities apply. Blasters deal energy, vibroweapons kinetic, and ion damage is the one that hurts droids and shields specifically.

armorClassification.description: Proficiency group the armour belongs to, which also decides how the Dexterity modifier applies to armor class. Present on armour only.

armorClass.description: The armor class this armour provides, as printed, including how Dexterity is applied: "13 + Dex modifier (max 2)", "18". Shields record their bonus instead, as "+2". Stored as text because the formula and its cap are part of the value. Present on armour only.

stealthDisadvantage.description: Whether wearing or carrying the item imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Always present, including when false, so a character sheet can total it without a null check.
